blocks.text: Cell theory ko kai observations aur experiments (tajurbon) se sach sabit kiya ja sakta hai. Misal ke taur par:

items: Light microscopes aur electron microscopes se scientists cell ki banawat dekhte hain aur tangible (thos, nazar aane wala) saboot paate hain ke cells waqai tamam jandaron ki structural units hain.

Live-cell imaging (zinda cell ki tasweeren lena) aur genetic studies jaisi techniques se scientists dekh sakte hain ke cells kaise replicate (apni nakal) hote hain aur naye cells banate hain. Is se yeh usool sabit hota hai ke tamam cells pehle se maujood cells se aate hain.

DNA sequencing jaisi techniques dikhati hain ke cells ka genetic material aur metabolic pathways (cell ke andar kimiyai raaste) mushtarak (shared) hain. Is se yeh baat mazboot hoti hai ke cell zindagi ki bunyadi unit hai.

Cell culture studies (lab mein cells ugana) aur tissue engineering jaise experiments cells ka barhna, differentiation (khaas kaam ke cell ban jana) aur reproduction dikha kar cell theory ko sabit karte hain.
